title: Darya Hai Abbas ka
body:
abbas alamdar alamdare hussaini
<<DIVIDER>>
hat jao shaamiyon hat jao kufiyon
mai ibne murtaza hoo mere naam hai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil pe aamad e khalafe bu turab hai
dehshat se mauj mauj ka dil aab aab hai
kis pehar ka jalaal ghazab ka itaab hai
gayti ko zalzala hai ke matti kharaab hai
roohul ameen ko khuaf se wasvaas aate hai
wasvaas kyun na aaye ke abbas aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye darya hai abbas ka ye darya hai abbas ka
khud pani sadayein deta hai har khatra hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
<<DIVIDER>>
bhatke na koi ab saahil par ye saara ilaaka hai mera
ay ghasib e haq e zahra suno ye pani mehr hai zehra ka
mai teesra beta hoo unka ye virsa hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shaamiyon tum mein hai hi nahi abbas se ladne ki himmat
is darya mein hi doob maro baaki hai agar thodi ghairat
atthara laakh nigahon mein kyun khatra hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
naara kiya wo rokne waale kahan gaye
tayghein wo kis taraf hai wo bhaale kahan gaye
lekar khat e shakast risaale kahan gaye
shimr o umar ki godh ke paale kahan gaye
zinda abhi hai ya pisar e saad mar gaya
khaali pada hai dasht ye khooli kidhar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
hat jao shaamiyon hat jao kufiyon
mai ibne murtaza hoo mere naam hai abbas
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh haan to kahe mai haakim ko uske hi mehal mein maarunga
ay shaamiyon shaam se pehle mai is shaam pe qabza kar lunga
ye baat nahi afsaano ki ye daawa hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas itaa'at mein har dam psaband hai apne aaqa ka
pehle jo hata tha darya se wo hukm tha mere aaqa ka
ab hatna padega tum sab ko ye rasta hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
o shimr apni fauj ka andher dekh le
ek dam mein bismilon ke huwe dher dekh le
bhaage hai jis se sher wo shamsher dekh le
o bekhabar taraayi pe hai sher dekh le
ladte hai yun hi zabr jo aate hai baat par
ab hashr tak hai sher ka qabza faraat par
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar to baahar aane do tum sab ki mai jurrat dekhunga
haan kis ka hai darya saahil par jis dam mai aakar poochunga
khud thodi dayr mein bologe abbas ka hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai khul ke agar hamla kar doon wo khoon ka darya darya mein
mai taygh yahan par khaynchunga aur shor uthega kufa mein
muslim se kahenge baba bhi ye hamla hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e hussain sayyed o sardar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
ay ahle haram meer o alamdar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqe se giraya hai khud ko ye keh ke ali ki beti ne
kulsoom se boli lagta hai abbas khada hai pehle se
ye khushboo hai chote bhai ki ye saaya hai abbas ka ya
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad kaha usne ro kar ay jaan meri qasim utho
shahzade abhi tak pyase ho ammu ki qasam pani peelo
sairaab ho jee bhar ke beta ab qabza hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
author: Mir Sajjad Mir
